title: GDC/TCGA open-access somatic mutation aggregate track pack (hg38)
context: The NCI GDC open-access tier provides aggregate somatic mutation files (MAF format) from TCGA studies without controlled-access genotype data. This is a Priority-B source: redistribution terms must be verified per-study/file before any track is built. The re-identification check is particularly critical here — even open-access TCGA MAF files may contain variant patterns from small cohorts that could be re-identifying; any such signal forces EXCLUDE per the cancer guardrail. This task is blocked on catalog-014 confirming at least one GDC study as APPROVED.
objective: Verify redistribution rights for a specific GDC/TCGA open-access somatic MAF study through catalog-014, run the licensegate-002 gate including re-identification check, and if APPROVED, build an aggregate somatic mutation track pack on hg38.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one specific GDC/TCGA study is confirmed APPROVED in catalog-014 with cited redistribution terms and permitsRedistribution: true.
Re-identification check run and PASS recorded; track is derived from an open-tier aggregate MAF with no small-cohort re-identification signal.
licensegate-002 and coordgate-003 PASS artifacts committed for the selected study.
If gate FAILS or re-identification signal is found, task is marked EXCLUDED with the reason documented and no track is built.

If gate PASSES: all three browser targets emitted and render-verified; per-feature provenance records GDC case/file UUIDs, study ID, and open-access terms; provenance completeness ≥ 90/100; not-medical-advice notice present.
resources: NCI GDC data portal (open-access tier): https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov/
PLAN.md §7 (GDC/TCGA open somatic — Verify B → gate per file)
output: output/packs/gdc-somatic-hg38/ — aggregate somatic track file(s), browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/ds-gdcopen-010.json (or EXCLUDED record if gate fails).
